consequence.statement: Loki keeps running but exports the embedded cache metrics under the new loki_embeddedcache_* names, so any dashboard, alert or other consumer querying the old querier_cache_* names no longer matches those metrics.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alert rules and other metric consumers to the new loki_embeddedcache_* metric names.

original.statement: In Loki 3.0.0 the embedded cache metrics are renamed: querier_cache_added_new_total, querier_cache_evicted_total, querier_cache_entries and querier_cache_memory_bytes become loki_embeddedcache_added_new_total, loki_embeddedcache_evicted_total, loki_embeddedcache_entries and loki_embeddedcache_memory_bytes respectively.

decision.reason: [ev-1f9807113c9e] says the four querier_cache_* embedded cache metrics are renamed to loki_embeddedcache_* names. Loki keeps exporting the same metrics, only under new names. Nothing in the evidence says Loki or any component fails, rejects anything or loses access, so a review-class behavior-change at low severity is the right reading. Its statement (consumers of the old names stop matching) follows directly from the rename and does not over-claim mandatory work. The sibling items [ev-dd7907f24ce5] and [ev-53101f583cb5] cover separate metric removals and do not change this item.
